name: L7 Game UI
body: `chaos-ui`: the main menu, pause menu and HUD through the existing C++ bridge (`native/`, `lantern_chaos_ui.h`), called through `nox bind-c`, with layout and drawing ported to Nox.

acceptance_criteria.text: The menus and HUD look and behave as on the Rust engine, with keyboard, gamepad and mouse
Dean runs it on his Mac

definition_of_done.text: PR into `nox-proto`, reviewed, with the milestone's checks passing
